legal.title: Privacy, copyright & sources
legal.independent: NOBI Racing is independent, with no affiliation, sponsorship or endorsement from the Formula 1 companies, FIA, teams or drivers. Names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
legal.disclaimer: Independent fan project, unaffiliated with Formula 1 or the FIA. Trademarks belong to their owners. Photo dates, events and licenses appear in captions; no official endorsement.
legal.content: The personal local reader displays source RSS headlines and short summaries with local machine translation or AI-assisted Chinese editorial corrections. Original text and publisher links are retained. Chinese versions may contain errors and are not publisher-provided translations. Summaries are not full articles; article bodies, publisher images and video are not fetched. F1/FIA headline ingestion still requires a valid grant. Weekend reference is adapted from OpenF1 under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for personal non-commercial use; basic reference metadata comes from Wikidata CC0. Standings and development samples marked MOCK are synthetic or fictional. Verify actual arrangements and results at official sources.
legal.privacy: Language, theme, time zone, follow IDs and original news bookmark links are stored only in this browser. Bookmarks do not store source article bodies, headlines or points snapshots. Clear follows and bookmarks in Settings; remove all preferences using your browser's site data controls. This version has no registration, advertising trackers or third-party analytics. Images are served locally. The deployment server may process IP addresses, request times and paths for security and rate limiting; the operator and log retention must be defined before launch. External links are subject to the destination's privacy policy.
legal.rights: For inaccurate content or suspected infringement, retain the page URL, original work link and ownership evidence. The operator can revoke a source grant to stop ingestion and remove its cache. A working correction, complaints and privacy contact must be provided before public operation; this local development version has no public request channel yet.
legal.operator: Local development preview, not publicly operated. Operator identity, contact address, complaints channel, territories and applicable registrations or permits remain outstanding. This page is not a legal compliance certification. Review the actual service, hosting jurisdiction and applicable content licensing requirements before launch. Disclaimers do not replace permissions or registration.
legal.photoPolicy: Real photographs used as archive illustrations. The Ferrari image depicts historic cars photographed in 2018; the Audi image depicts a 2026 show car. Neither is presented as a current race or a fictional team's car. Copyright licenses do not grant trademark rights or endorsement.
legal.modifications: Original files are unmodified; displayed crops depend on the container. The Ferrari photograph and applicable adaptations are offered under CC BY-SA 2.0, independently of the site's code license.

publicData.privacy: Preferences and follows stay on-device. Forum usernames, salted password hashes and submitted content are stored on the Hong Kong server. Usernames and approved content are public. Session tokens stay in page memory; sign out or delete your account in the forum. No page access logs are written; IP counters last up to two minutes. Cloudflare processes connection/security data under its policy. Forum content is moderated and can be reported/deleted.
publicData.banner: Public edition: F1DB open reference and NOBI factual summaries with CC BY 4.0 attribution. Not live or official.
publicData.newsDescription: NOBI bilingual factual briefs based on F1DB open race and qualifying classifications.
publicData.newsUsage: NOBI generates factual summaries from CC BY 4.0 race data and links to the original data. No BBC or official news bodies are republished. Dates refer to the session; source classifications may be revised.
publicData.interval: Source checked every 2 minutes; dependent on source publication
publicData.weekendDescription: Calendar and start times come from F1DB open data. Session end times marked ≈ are NOBI estimates, not final organizer schedules. Check the organizer for changes.
publicData.statsDescription: Read 2026 points, gaps and trends using F1DB open standings and race results.
publicData.gainNote: Race gains come from F1DB classifications; cumulative points and order come from source standings. Rank changes are omitted when the real pre-race rank is unavailable.
publicData.statsNote: F1DB · CC BY 4.0 · NOBI labels and charts · Historical reference, not live or official final results.
publicData.photoPending: No verified image is available for the latest weekend yet.
publicData.dataLicense: Public schedules, standings and race brief data come from F1DB under CC BY 4.0 with attribution. NOBI adds Chinese labels, charts and factual summaries. Start times come from the dataset; marked end times are estimates. No paid live timing feed is provided.
publicData.operator: NOBI Racing is an independent fan project, unaffiliated with F1, the FIA or teams. Submit maintenance or rights feedback through the forum and reporting tools.
publicData.contentPolicy: The public edition uses F1DB CC BY 4.0 structured data and NOBI factual summaries. Current weekend photos use the team's expressly offered non-commercial editorial media permission, with copyright and terms preserved; no advertising, merchandise or resale use. Official links support source verification, not republication of official news or logos.
publicData.heroCopy: Follow the latest weekend through Chinese race briefs and traceable open classifications. Photos identify their real session and capture date.
